title: Not crimson, more cherry red
text: Not crimson, more cherry red. Good quality, lies flat and appears well made. The color though-- as you can see, 1)is a bright cherry red dog toy and 2)is a crimson pillow. The rug is closer to bright cherry red than it is crimson. As someone else on here said, its true Brick red. Will likely return, as now i know what they meant. It is very good quality though, for amazon! Update: im trying to return this rug and the seller has not yet returned my money, though they accepted the return. It has been about 6 business days since i sent it via UPS. I am starting to get angry, and worried.
